news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.36 (vs ₹0.71 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.36 (down from ₹0.71 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹286.8m (down 40% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹9.00m (down 49% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.1% (down from 3.7% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 42% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 15% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
